title: MiST: Mid-Training LLMs for Cybersecurity
abstract: arXiv:2609.18496v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cybersecurity combines high-stakes analysis with complex technical language, making it an impactful and challenging domain for LLMs. We present MiST (Mid-trained Security Transformer), a suite of 8B and 32B models that achieve strong performance on public cybersecurity benchmarks. We use mid-training as an intermediate adaptation stage between general pre-training and cybersecurity training. Rather than performing continual pre-training over large volumes of raw domain text, we curate a compact, expert-vetted seed corpus, and transform it into high-quality domain-specific synthetic training data. The final MiST checkpoints improve mean cybersecurity accuracy by +13.1 and +8.6 absolute percentage points over the corresponding Qwen baselines for 8B and 32B, respectively, corresponding to relative gains of +27.0% and +15.8%. translated_title: MiST：面向网络安全的LLM中间训练
translated_abstract: 网络安全结合了高风险分析与复杂的技术语言，使其成为大语言模型（LLM）应用中兼具影响力与挑战性的领域。我们提出了MiST（Mid-trained Security Transformer，中间训练安全转换器），这是一系列在公开网络安全基准测试中取得优异表现的8B和32B模型。我们将中间训练用作通用预训练与网络安全训练之间的中间适应阶段。与对大量原始领域文本进行持续预训练不同，我们精心构建了一个紧凑的、经专家审核的种子语料库，并将其转化为高质量的领域特定合成训练数据。最终的MiST模型检查点在8B和32B规模上，相比相应的Qwen基线，平均网络安全准确率分别提升了13.1和8.6个绝对百分点，对应相对提升分别为27.0%和15.8%。消融实验结果进一步表明，这些网络安全性能的提升源于中间训练和监督微调阶段。
tldr: MiST通过将经专家审核的紧凑种子语料库转化为高质量领域合成数据进行中间训练，使8B和32B模型在网络安全基准测试上较Qwen基线分别提升13.1和8.6个绝对百分点的准确率。
